changelog:
- Initial release of skill-publish-guide.
- Provides a comprehensive guide for publishing, updating, deleting, and managing skills on ClawHub.
- Includes detailed SKILL.md formatting instructions, directory structure, and security best practices (bilingual: English & Chinese).
- Outlines required CLI commands, publishing workflow, and troubleshooting for common issues.
- Designed to assist users at every step of the ClawHub skill lifecycle.
